conceptsImplemented.name: Plane-aware multi-series aggregation
conceptsImplemented.why: Sagittal/coronal/axial emphasize different structures (ACL sagittal, MCL coronal, PF OA axial). Pooling all series together dilutes plane-specific signal and hurts macro AUC equally across 12 targets.
conceptsImplemented.how: Encode slices → series emb → fixed plane slots + availability mask; never treat missing plane as clinical negative.

conceptsImplemented.name: Weak supervision from multilingual reports
conceptsImplemented.why: Only ~58 gold labels vs thousands of reports. Ignoring reports leaves ranking models undertrained; hard pseudo-labels from negation mistakes invert targets.
conceptsImplemented.how: Negation/uncertainty/temporality-aware parser → soft labels + confidence weights; calibrate on gold folds only; never use test reports.

Mix 0.50·v4_stack + 0.50·qwen on ACL only if std>1e-8. Never open test reports. Do not remix Gemini Baker's or v4/Gemini ACL/Effusion/LM weights.

conceptsImplemented.name: Anatomy-oriented multi-task MRI (KAMRNet / slice transformers)
conceptsImplemented.why: Xie et al. 2025 (eClinicalMedicine) trained KAMRNet on 13,419 patients / 14,962 exams for nine knee abnormalities and reported internal primary AUCs ~0.90; a 2026 23-condition slice-transformer (European Radiology) reached median external AUC ~0.78. Those numbers are the visual-model ceiling, not a metadata ceiling. We cannot spend quota on them until real train DICOMs/JPEGs + GPU time are mounted.
conceptsImplemented.how: When pixels are available: plane-slot encoder, anatomy-oriented localization, then rank-ensemble with gold_rank_interact rather than replacing it.

conceptsImplemented.name: Per-target calibrated prevalence prior blend
conceptsImplemented.why: Macro AUC cares about ranking per target. Pure constant prevalence (~0.49 public) is a floor; blending study-level model logits with target prevalence stabilizes rare labels (MCL, Baker's).
conceptsImplemented.how: p = clip((1-α)·σ(logit) + α·prev_t); tune α on OOF; larger α for rare/unstable heads.

conceptsImplemented.name: Fluid-sensitive / fat-suppression series routing
conceptsImplemented.why: train_series.csv exposes Fluid_Sensitive and Fat_Suppression. Contusion/effusion/synovitis benefit from fluid-sensitive series; bone findings may prefer others.
conceptsImplemented.how: Weight series embeddings by sequence flags before plane pooling; ablate via ASRA H-routing.

conceptsImplemented.name: Frozen encoder then last-block unfreeze
conceptsImplemented.why: Tiny gold set overfits if the full backbone trains early. Frozen ImageNet/RadImageNet encoder + heads first is the reliable baseline.
conceptsImplemented.how: Train heads only until OOF beats prevalence; then unfreeze last block at low LR.

conceptsImplemented.name: Target-specific view preference soft regularizer
conceptsImplemented.why: Hard rules (no sagittal ⇒ ACL=0) destroy recall. Soft preferred-plane coverage features improve ranking without forcing zeros.
conceptsImplemented.how: Concatenate preferred-plane coverage; small consistency loss only after ablation accepts it.

conceptsImplemented.name: Ensemble fold checkpoints + rank average
conceptsImplemented.why: Single fold on 58 labels is noisy. Probability or rank ensembling across folds lifts macro AUC more than architecture churn.
conceptsImplemented.how: Save fold*.pt; at inference mean probs or average ranks then rescale to [eps,1-eps].
